title: Implement a version parser to an exact written specification
prompt: Implement parse_version and compare_versions in src/version.py exactly as the specification in docs/VERSION_SPEC.md describes. The specification is precise and every clause matters, including the ordering rules for pre-release identifiers and the handling of build metadata. Do not invent behaviour the specification does not state, and do not import a third-party version library - the standard library only.
acceptance_criteria: parse_version returns a Version with major, minor, patch, prerelease tuple and build string.
A malformed version raises InvalidVersion with the offending input in the message.
Leading zeroes in numeric identifiers are rejected, as the specification requires.
Build metadata is parsed but ignored entirely when comparing.
A version with a pre-release sorts before the same version without one.
Numeric pre-release identifiers compare numerically and sort before alphanumeric ones.
A longer pre-release chain sorts after a shorter one when all preceding identifiers are equal.
compare_versions returns -1, 0 or 1 and is consistent with sorting.
